window_utc.note: The platform reports insufficient bounded history; this 15-day window cannot establish expectancy or stability.

trade.note: Entry and stop are timestamped in the same 15m bar. This single simulator path does not resolve intrabar execution ambiguity.

limitations: These are TakeProfit simulator fills, not user or exchange fills.
The 15 bp cost_fraction informs candidate eligibility and sizing; it is not directly debited as a complete spread/slippage cost in these simulator PnL metrics.
The tool-applied commission is 5 bp per side. The account's actual fee tier, spread, slippage and funding remain unknown.
The configured reward target remains 1.5R, so a $1 risk cap cannot produce the user's desired $5 or more gross target without a separate reward/risk hypothesis; this run does not test such a change.
The dynamic Binance PERCENT_PRICE filter is captured in the evidence snapshot but is not checked by the native strategy adapter.
Do not infer profitability from zero trades or one losing simulated trade.
